scripts.format: pnpm format:web && pnpm format:api && pnpm format:docs
scripts.format:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff format apps/api
scripts.format:check: pnpm format:check:web && pnpm format:check:api && pnpm format:check:docs
scripts.format:check:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff format --check apps/api
scripts.lint:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.lint:check:api: uv run --project apps/api ruff check apps/api
scripts.type:check: pnpm type:check:web && pnpm type:check:client && pnpm type:check:api
scripts.type:check:api: uv run --project apps/api mypy --config-file apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/src apps/api/tests
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && pnpm test:client && pnpm test:api
scripts.test:api: uv run --project apps/api pytest -c apps/api/pyproject.toml apps/api/tests
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint:check && pnpm type:check && pnpm api-client:check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.prepare: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 && git config core.hooksPath .githooks || true
